diverse_anchor.text: Champion a proposal to ship this iteration. Highlight upside: latency drops and support tickets shrink. Defend the plan; marshal supporting reasons from the last canary. Push for adoption now and celebrate momentum rather than reopening settled scope.

Stress-test claims that the canary proved safety. Hunt hidden failure in the rollback path. Demand a counterexample where the same flag brick a region. Refuse unearned confidence. Name residual risk in the dual-write window and withhold assent until disproof of that window exists.

Cite mechanism: quorum loss under asymmetric partition. Quote measurement from the 14-minute replication lag histogram. Bound uncertainty at the p99. Compare prior art in the 2015 batch-window paper. Require an operational definition of 'caught up' and refuse anecdote; insist on units of seconds.

Speak as the operator who lives with the result at 03:00. Name switching cost of a second pager rotation. Ask who pays when the dashboard lies. Refuse hidden burden on the on-call. Demand reversible rollout so a night shift can undo without waiting on a vendor bridge.

Weigh both sides without joining either. Apply a stopping rule: no ship until the rollback drill is logged. Record the burden of proof on the proposer. Issue a scoped ruling covering only this flag. Stay silent on advocacy. Separate finding from preference; the finding is that the drill is absent.
